target_customer: Airlines, flight operations centers and pilots
problem: Dispatchers and pilots must read raw NOTAMs, weather and procedures by hand to plan each flight, which takes hours.
business_model: B2B SaaS and API for airlines plus pilot subscriptions via Notamify

founders.name: Damian Szumski
founders.background_notes: YC page says licensed flight dispatcher with about 10 years across flight operations, aviation data and software; was Product Owner for the Flightradar24 API. Education not stated.

competitors.name: ForeFlight (Jeppesen) ClearNOTAMs
competitors.what: Plain-English AI NOTAM summaries inside the ForeFlight app
competitors.traction_then: Large installed base of ForeFlight pilot users

technical_complexity.rationale: Parsing and interpreting NOTAMs with models and checking them against a flight needs aviation domain data and reliability, but relies on existing models.

defensibility.rationale: Aeronautical data foundation and airline integrations take time to build; the NOTAM interpretation layer alone was reproducible, as ForeFlight showed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: ForeFlight shipped AI NOTAM summaries by mid 2026; no acquisition of Skymerse found.

market_need_then: NOTAM overload was a known problem; the 2023 FAA system outage drew attention and the NOTAM Alliance has pursued simplified briefings since 2023. Notamify launched on Product Hunt on 2024-05-13.

identity.visual_style: Dark technical UI with aviation code ticker (RWY, METAR), ISO 27001 badge
identity.voice_and_tone: Short lowercase tagline: plan less, fly more

brand_strength.rationale: Skymerse is a new umbrella name over the earlier Notamify brand, with little third-party coverage; product name Notamify has more recognition among pilots, but evidence is thin.

pivots.to: Skymerse platform for end to end flight operations
pivots.why: Founder describes expanding to a single AI system for flight operations

outcome_analysis: Skymerse is an active Summer 2026 company built on the earlier Notamify product, with a founder who is a licensed dispatcher and a former Flightradar24 API product owner. Traction is described only as airline customers and thousands of pilots, so the outcome is too early to read; competition from ForeFlight is the main watch item.
notes: Dealroom shows a $125k seed, unverified single aggregator, not recorded as a round. Location conflict: YC page says San Francisco, a search summary said Warsaw. Traction claims are self-reported. Completeness pass: the $125K seed entry rests on a single database (Dealroom) with date and investors paywalled; no press found.
